name: Pine Waves Regalia (Tùng Đào Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: while you stay Composed, every 3 s a wave goes out from you. Each wave: you heal 2 % of your health and the foe gains one Wood stack. Each wave is stronger than the last, and every wave after the fifth costs you 2 % of your maximum linh lực; the waves break if you stop being Composed.

story: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn made all three in the palace's first thirty years. Unlike the regalia of Băng Tâm and Thúy Vi, Tùng Đào's has never been split: Thôi Khinh Hồng handed all three to Đàm Tùng Lại in one morning in 900. The Coiled Root Hall says a head who gave up the Cold Ford should not wear them, and Đàm, who agrees more than he says, wears only the robe except at the new year.

name: The Governor's Charge (Thủ Tân Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: after you have not moved for 3 s, you take 12 % less damage and your roots last 1 s longer.

while you hold all three and stay Composed, the lantern lights a Field around you: while it is up, you heal 1 % of your health each second and the foe is Slowed; a foe that cannot evade for 2 s is struck by a palm counter.

story: The seal and the lantern of the Cold Ford governor, made in 672. Nhiếp Cô Tân has the seal; the lantern was left on the quay at Hàn Tân in 905. He would give a great deal for it, and more for the war that would let him walk onto that quay and look. The governor's coat, made with them, came off Giáp Tùng Chi's body in Nhiếp's hands that day, so he wears two of the three; the Charge is whole only with the lantern from under the quay stones.

name: The Ferryman's Remedy (Độ Gia Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: when you heal below half health, you also shed one poison stack and gain one Wood buff stack; once every 6 s.

story: A gourd from the ferry and needles wound in its rope: Bồ Hạnh Lâm made the second piece in 1185 to match the first. Both are Đàm Thanh Giang's, and the set is whole.

name: Cut Bridges (Đoạn Kiều Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: the first time in a fight a foe falls below half health from your hits, your next flying-sword hit on it is a certain crit, and the foe cannot evade for 1 s.

story: Her father's blade and the rope of the bridge he died on, which came home together in 1174. Nhiếp Vãn Đào holds both.

name: Swan Goose and Swimming Dragon (Kinh Hồng Du Long)

bonuses.rule: each time the Sash slips a blow, you regrow 4 % of your health over 4 s and the attacker cannot evade for 1 s, so the Fang's resistance cut applies to it.

story: Not made together: the founder's sash of 200, the wolf king's tooth of 455 and the pin she cut in 900. She bound them with one cord the morning she retired, and they have answered one another since. All three are hers; the Thousand Roots Banner stays furled at Thính Đào Nhãn.

name: Relics of Still Water (Tĩnh Thủy Tam Di)

bonuses.rule: each Water art the Lamp makes free counts twice toward the Ring's ninth bend, and when the ninth wave bends back it also heals you for 3 % of your maximum linh lực.

story: The abbey's lamp, her mother's habit and the River Hall's ring: two relics of the flood of 700 and the hand of the man who sent it. Dụ Tĩnh Lưu wears all three, and only she knows why that is a penance.

name: Rain over the Long Lake (Trường Hồ Vũ)

bonuses.rule: while your Pine Rain falls, each heal you receive also gives you one Water buff stack and restores 1 % of your maximum linh lực; heals on you below a third of your health are 25 % stronger.

story: The teaching fan, the pearl from home and the robe of the Hall of Voices, gathered over three centuries. All are Hồ Tùng Nguyệt's, and the hall expects them to pass to whoever keeps it after her.

name: The Unwritten Score (Vô Tự Cầm Phổ)

bonuses.rule: while you cast Wood arts with no gap over 1.5 s, each art gives you one Song stack (2 % Wood art speed and 3 % soul resistance each), and each Song fades 8 s after you gain it. A soul art or a silence that would land on you takes 4 Song instead.

story: A zither from Vạn Hác's head, a pendant from Vạn Hác's head and a robe from her own master. Vi Thanh Âm holds all three. The set's name is the palace's joke for the canon that is never written down; she does not laugh at it.

name: The Ice-Breaker's Array (Phá Băng Trận Cụ)

bonuses.rule: arrays and curses you lay in the first 5 s of a fight last 50 % longer, and while your array (a Field) is up, a foe that stays cursed for 3 s cannot evade for 1.5 s and takes a Water stack; once every 10 s.

story: The nine flags of 904, a seal for the ward-songs and his father's keel. Cận Tùng Hàn holds all three, and the flags are still rolled; the set has not been worn whole since that winter.
